parsed.summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue by ensuring that the new alias does not intersect with existing aliases, but it may not be the most efficient or minimal solution.

issues.description: The change introduces a loop to find a non-intersecting alias, which may not be the most efficient approach. It could potentially lead to performance issues if the number of existing aliases is large.
The code could benefit from additional comments to explain the purpose of the loop and why it is necessary.
